log: 📖 LEARNED: Wiring & Circuits (Level 2). 12V systems: batteries, charge controllers, and what you can actually run off a car battery.
📖 Your old life taught you things. 1 skill from your past — check your Journal.
Nothing here looks like home. You know none of these plants. Learn fast.
📖 Your hands remember: knap a Stone knife (stone + vine) — the oldest tool there is. Find the stone.
📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Ellis Murphy. Appliance repair tech. From Minneapolis, USA. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Reading Glasses, Dead Phone, Carpenter's square, Field suture kit, Father's Whetstone. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. You heard it in the dark. Breathing. Not yours. It knew your name — it said it wrong, like it learned the shape of the sound but not what it meant.
A man, maybe 40s, with tattooed arms: "Don't bother picking around the tents. Walk out. The land feeds people who go looking."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
🐞 SCENARIO: hushpuppy. The birds went quiet. Something is circling, three tiles east.
🐕 It moves.
You don't know what that was. a dog-shaped silence at the treeline Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ A DOG-SHAPED SILENCE AT THE TREELINE! (3 of them!) You're on your own.
